import pandas as pd

df = read_df('sales_data.csv')

# --- Column-level summary (count, unique, missing) ---
profile = pd.DataFrame({
    'dtype': df.dtypes,
    'count': df.count(),
    'missing': df.isna().sum(),
    'missing_%': (df.isna().mean() * 100).round(2),
    'unique': df.nunique(),
})
print(profile)

# --- Numeric stats (count, mean, std, min, max, quartiles) ---
print("\nNumerical columns describe:")
print(df.describe().T)

# --- Categorical / object stats (count, unique, top, freq) ---
obj_cols = df.select_dtypes(include=['object', 'category']).columns
if len(obj_cols):
    print("\nCategorical columns describe:")
    print(df[obj_cols].describe().T)

# --- Date ranges (parse date columns) ---
for c in ['order_date', 'ship_date']:
    if c in df.columns:
        s = pd.to_datetime(df[c], errors='coerce')
        print(f"\n{c}: min={s.min()}, max={s.max()}, missing={s.isna().sum()}")
